name: BunZ
notes: 4 printed menu pages: a Breakfast Menu (©2024), a Dinner Menu (©2025), a Lunch & Dinner Menu, and a wine/dessert/beverage page. The Lunch & Dinner page overlaps the Dinner Menu with a few conflicting prices for the same item (e.g. All American Classic Burger 12.99 vs 14.99, Smoked Bacon 'n' Cheddar 14.99 vs 16.99, Cobb salad 12.99 vs 13.99) — kept the Dinner Menu's (newer, 2025) price and dropped the duplicate, but kept items unique to the Lunch & Dinner page (extra burgers, salads, tortas, pasta).
